frame.origin: the building's leeward (downwind) wall centre on the ground; x = 0 is the leeward wall
frame.x: +x streamwise (the wind blows toward +x); the building spans x in [-0.08, 0]; the floor source is at x = +0.04
frame.y: +y lateral; the building spans y in [-0.04, 0.04]; the z/H = 0.025 plane is measured on the y <= 0 side only
frame.z: +z up; roof at z = 0.16; heated floor at z = 0

files.format: ASCII STL, LF line endings, outward normals, every body closed and consistently wound
files.source: generated from the readme's stated dimensions b = 0.08 m, H = 0.16 m; the leeward wall is the origin (MP-y_caseJ.png, MP-z_caseJ.png)
files.render_caption: Isolated 1:1:2 building, b = 0.08 m, H = 0.16 m (model scale); the orange ring marks the floor tracer source, 0.25 H behind the building (seen through it); the wind blows along +x.
